About me

Thirty years in this business. Now I'd like to be your broker.

Stephen Botelho · Co-Founder & Managing Partner · P&C since 1994

For thirty years, I have built relationships across this industry and placed the people who run it. Now I bring that same judgment, and that same network, to what matters to you: your home, your family, your business, and everything you have built.

  • Everything under one roofHome, auto, boat, and umbrella on the personal side. Liability, workers comp, transportation, and property on the commercial side. Bring it all to me, one relationship for the whole picture.
  • From a diamond ring to a craneI broker the everyday and the unusual: valuables and floaters, classic cars, cargo, contractors equipment, cranes, even refineries. If it needs coverage, I can place it.
  • You get me, not a call centerYou deal with me directly. Thirty years of relationships means that when you call, a real person who knows you picks up and gets it handled.
  • The whole desk behind himI am backed by a full specialty operation, including our Chief Underwriting Officer Rich Rooney for the truly hard-to-place. Nothing is too complex.

Whatever you own and whatever you have built, I would be glad to look after it.
